metadata.description: Marketplace for spec-flow — a spec-driven workflow plugin for Claude Code.

plugins.name: sf
plugins.description: Approve one design doc; the agent builds it, tests it for real and opens the PR. Lightweight spec-driven development for Claude Code and Codex.

_notes.standalone: spec-flow is self-contained: one `/plugin install sf` is all a team member needs. The manual-test and commit skills ship INSIDE this plugin (skills/manual-test, skills/commit). Branch policy (1 SD = 1 branch, no commit on base) is config-driven via .spec-flow/config.json → branching. The task engine is bundled, zero-network and CLI-only (bin/flow-tools.cjs, bin/task-master) — the plugin declares no MCP server, fetches no external package, and needs no manual install.
_notes.member-prereqs: node >= 18 and the Claude Code CLI. No API key needed by default — /sf:init sets the task engine to the keyless `claude-code` provider (uses your Claude Code session). An ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / PERPLEXITY_API_KEY is optional, only if a member prefers their own provider.
